business_summary: UOGroup CO.,LTD. engages in the retail sale of seafood in Japan. The company provides fresh fish, sushi, prepared food, private label products, e-commerce offering, and wholesale offering, and operates conveyor belt sushi restaurant and other food service business. Through its subsidiary, it manages and operates supermarkets and provides real estate leasing and tenant management service. The company also operates Uoki Shonan Kitchen. The company was formerly known as Uoki Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to UOGroup CO.,LTD. in May 2026. UOGroup CO.,LTD. was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Fujisawa, Japan.
